tasks.title: Bookmark manager MVP
acceptance: Users can add, list, delete and search bookmarks through a JSON API and a single-page UI
npm test passes on main after all tasks merge

tasks.title: Architecture: scaffold, API contract, shared types and acceptance tests
acceptance: docs/api.md defines GET/POST /api/bookmarks, DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id and GET /api/bookmarks?q=
src/types.ts exports Bookmark { id, url, title, tags, createdAt } and NewBookmark
src/app.ts builds the Hono app from stub modules in src/api, src/store, src/search and serves public/
tests/acceptance/{api,ui,search,e2e}.test.ts exist and typecheck; they may fail until later tasks land
All dependencies are installed; later tasks never edit package.json
tasks.prompt: You are the architecture task. Create the scaffold and contracts every later task builds against. Stub modules must export the final function signatures and throw new Error('not implemented').

tasks.title: Bookmark API and in-memory store
acceptance: POST /api/bookmarks validates url and title and returns 201 with the bookmark
GET /api/bookmarks lists newest first; DELETE /api/bookmarks/:id returns 204, or 404 if unknown

tasks.title: Single-page web UI
acceptance: public/index.html has a form (#add-form with url, title, tags) and a list (#bookmarks)
The page calls the API from docs/api.md with fetch; no build step and no external CDN

tasks.title: Tag and text search
acceptance: searchBookmarks(list, query) matches title and url case-insensitively and supports tag:<name> terms
